profile.headline: Senior C# Software Developer
profile.summary:
Solid software development, business to software process analysis, user experience methodologies, software design and team management. Excellent client interview/management, requirements gathering, specification documentation, leadership and people skills. 

C#, .NET Core, ASP.Net, MVC, Domain-Driven Design, Test-Driven Development, Mocks, Fakes, MS SQL Server, Database Design/Development, Restful Web API Services, Entity Framework, Dependency Injection. SOLID design principles. Expressions, Generics. Rules, Command, Repository, Unit of Work, Facade, Adapter, Builder, Factory, Null, Strategy and more design patterns. Team Foundation Server. Agile/Scrum.
